title: RPAM: A Principled Metric for Evaluating Associations in Language Models with High Predictive Validity in Downstream Outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differential associations between European American and African American names and pleasant/unpleasant attributes using the Relative Probability Association Metric (RPAM) to measure normalized continuation probabilities.
Measuring differential associations between male/female names or terms and stereotypical concepts like career/family, math/arts, and science/arts using RPAM.
Quantifying the association magnitude between young and old names and pleasant versus unpleasant words using normalized continuation probabilities via RPAM.
Assessing implicit associations between mental/physical disease terms and concepts of temporary versus permanent states using the RPAM metric.
